   - low-quality/low-violence fallback selection requires runtime/profile context and emits `VFX_PHASE_LOW_SETTING_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` when guessed at parse time
   - low-quality/low-violence fallback selection stays separate from Blender/PoC display-quality controls and must preserve the source fallback field path in cache keys
   - beam-capable rows require effect-instance source/effector/body-node context before canonical scheduling and emit `VFX_PHASE_BEAM_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` otherwise
   - repeated-row duration dedup and transform-refresh delay stay retail-validation targets, not parser rewrites
3. `progfx.2da` optional link preservation.
   - `ProgFX_Impact`, `ProgFX_Duration`, and `ProgFX_Cessation` stay attached to their original phase slots
   - `ProgFX_*` refs are phase/run hooks, not MDL emitter rows, sound refs, or Blender particle settings
   - local decompilation absence of `progfx` records `VFX_PROGFX_LOCAL_DECOMP_ABSENT` when `progfx` behavior is presented as Aurora-proven instead of EE/external evidence
   - selected `progfx.2da` source rows preserve client/server/toolset loading profile and `0..65535` row-limit evidence; missing profile emits `VFX_PROGFX_CLIENT_TABLE_PROFILE_REQUIRED` / `VFX_PROGFX_ROW_LIMIT_PROFILE_REQUIRED`
   - missing `progfx.2da` in a legacy/non-EE profile does not fail rows with no `ProgFX_*` refs
   - missing `progfx.2da` with present `ProgFX_*` refs preserves the refs and emits diagnostics
   - bare `progfx.2da` rows without owning `visualeffects.2da` row ID, phase field path, and effect-instance context emit `VFX_PROGFX_PHASE_OWNER_VISUALEFFECTS_REQUIRED` / `VFX_PROGFX_NOT_STANDALONE_EFFECT_SOURCE`
   - `Label`, `Type`, and `Param1..Param8` are preserved with raw cells and provenance
   - `Type` column wins over conventional row-number buckets and records `VFX_PROGFX_TYPE_COLUMN_AUTHORITATIVE`; bucket mismatch emits diagnostics but does not rewrite the row
   - unknown `Type` values preserve params and emit typed diagnostics
   - `Param8` is preserved even when no current typed interpretation uses it
   - Type-specific param validation does not treat all `Param*` values as one global schema and emits `VFX_PROGFX_TYPE_SCHEMA_SOURCE_REQUIRED` when source/provenance is missing
   - typed param interpretation requires the selected `Type` discriminator and emits `VFX_PROGFX_PARAM_TYPE_DISCRIMINATOR_REQUIRED` if a parser exposes resource/unit semantics before dispatch
   - typed param units carry profile metadata and emit `VFX_PROGFX_PARAM_UNIT_PROFILE_REQUIRED` when a value is consumed without unit/source evidence
   - `Param1..Param8` typed payloads record owner table/source row provenance and emit `VFX_PROGFX_PARAM_OWNER_TABLE_REQUIRED` if owner context is missing
   - local decompilation `Param1`/`Param1Value` and `ReqParam1`/`ReqParam2` strings emit `VFX_PROGFX_PARAM_NAME_STRING_NOT_LOCAL_PROOF` when used as ProgFX proof without a `progfx.2da` call-site
   - item-property/GFF parameter rows cannot seed programmed-FX params; doing so emits `VFX_PROGFX_PARAM_ITEMPROP_SCHEMA_COLLISION`
   - missing or nonstandard `Param*` columns are preserved from the selected table and emit `VFX_PROGFX_SCHEMA_MUST_COME_FROM_SELECTED_SOURCE` instead of being filled from generic local strings
   - Type 1 damage chunk VFX refs resolve separately from the parent row's VFX ID
   - Type 4 light/vision priority parameters are preserved and marked unverified for canonical browser lighting
   - Type 7 beam rows require an effect-instance beam context before canonical preview and emit `VFX_PROGFX_EFFECT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` when source/target/body-node data is missing
   - Type 8 delete-model and Type 9 hardcoded-chunk rows are preserved but non-canonical without retail validation
   - Type 10 MIRV projectile rows preserve projectile model, spells.2da link, orientation/path type, and timing-curve token; `dm_visualeffect`-only validation emits `VFX_PROGFX_DM_VISUALEFFECT_INSUFFICIENT`
   - Type 12 model-node VFX rows diagnose unresolved target nodes without guessing anchors
   - Type 12 and other `progfx.2da` model params that resolve MDL/VFX models use the spawned-model mesh lane and emit `VFX_SPAWNED_MODEL_NOT_PARTICLE_QUAD` if routed through the textured-particle quad renderer
   - `vfx_persistent.2da` attempts to consume arbitrary `progfx.2da` rows are diagnosed as cross-table/profile mismatch and record `VFX_PROGFX_VFX_PERSISTENT_PROFILE_MISMATCH`
   - `Type_FD = B`/Beam family is not interpreted as emitter `render Beam`
   - parsed `AuroraProgrammedFxSourceRow` data cannot create a canonical preview until an `AuroraProgrammedFxRuntimeRequest` supplies phase field path and effect-instance context; row-only attempts emit `VFX_PROGFX_RUNTIME_REQUEST_REQUIRED` and `VFX_PROGFX_ROW_ONLY_PREVIEW_FORBIDDEN`
   - typed payload tests preserve raw `Param1..Param8` while exposing type-specific views, and emit `VFX_PROGFX_PARAM_RAW_AND_TYPED_PRESERVED` if normalization drops raw cells
   - Type 1 nested visualeffects refs create dependency edges and cycle diagnostics without becoming `chunkName` emitters
   - Type 2 environment-map rows emit `VFX_PROGFX_TYPE2_ENVMAP_NOT_MTR_OVERRIDE` if routed into MTR/TXI envmap replacement, emitter texture, or particle shader uniforms without a programmed-effect material/appearance runtime request
   - Type 3/6 overlay rows remain non-canonical without target material/equipment context
   - Type 6 pulse timing emits `VFX_PROGFX_PARAM_TIMEBASE_NOT_EMITTER_FPS` / `VFX_PROGFX_TYPE6_PULSE_TIME_NOT_PARTICLE_LIFETIME` if mapped to emitter atlas `fps`, animation length, particle `lifeExp`, or generic browser tween timing
   - Type 4 light/vision rows enter a client-light/perception lane, not a generic renderer-light lane
   - Type 10/11 MIRV rows require source/target and spell/projectile edge provenance in the runtime request
   - Type 12 rows require target-node namespace and spawned-model lane; missing namespace emits `VFX_PROGFX_TYPE12_ATTACHMENT_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED`
   - cache-key tests prove two requests for the same `progfx.2da` row but different phase, transform, beam source, or target node do not reuse the same runtime payload

3.1. `vfx_persistent.2da` / AOE separation.
   - `EffectAreaOfEffect` uses a `vfx_persistent.2da` row ID and emits `VFX_AOE_ROW_ID_NOT_VISUALEFFECTS` if treated as a `visualeffects.2da` row
   - AOE source rows preserve `LABEL`, shape fields, event scripts, visual/model/sound footprint fields, raw cells, row ID, source layer, and schema provenance
   - `LABEL` is preserved as the created AOE object's tag/source label, but row/tag-only runtime keys emit `VFX_AOE_LABEL_TAG_NOT_UNIQUE_OBJECT_ID`
   - local decompilation absence of `vfx_persistent` and `EffectAreaOfEffect` records `VFX_AOE_VFX_PERSISTENT_LOCAL_DECOMP_ABSENT` before external schema is treated as runtime behavior
   - local `ONHEARTBEAT` string hits produce `VFX_AOE_ONHEARTBEAT_STRING_NOT_TABLE_PROOF` if used as proof of AOE table schema or cadence
   - OnEnter/Heartbeat/OnExit cells are script refs and emit `VFX_AOE_EVENT_SCRIPT_NOT_VFX_RESOURCE` if routed through model, emitter, texture, or Blender-node resolution
   - constructor-provided AOE scripts preserve override precedence and emit `VFX_AOE_SCRIPT_OVERRIDE_PRECEDENCE_REQUIRED` if flattened into table defaults or source rows
   - AOE application requires pseudo-object/runtime-object context and emits `VFX_AOE_PSEUDO_OBJECT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` when only a table row is available
   - mobile AOE and static AOE stay separate and emit `VFX_AOE_MOBILE_STATIC_SPLIT_REQUIRED` if collapsed into one location-only scene child
   - mobile AOE `GetEffectInteger`/`GetEffectString`/`GetEffectObject` observation remains profile-gated and emits `VFX_AOE_MOBILE_EFFECT_ACCESSOR_PROFILE_REQUIRED` if used as classic/local runtime proof
   - static location AOE lacks a removable parent effect on a followed object and emits `VFX_AOE_STATIC_NO_PARENT_EFFECT_REQUIRED` if implemented as a creature effect attachment
   - AOE row-ID limits are selected-profile evidence and never reuse `visualeffects.2da` WORD/uint16 assumptions; missing or copied limits emit `VFX_AOE_ROW_LIMIT_PROFILE_REQUIRED` or `VFX_AOE_ROW_LIMIT_NOT_VISUALEFFECTS_WORD`
   - `areaeffects.2da` is preserved as unused/cross-profile evidence and emits `VFX_AOE_AREAEFFECTS_UNUSED_TABLE` if treated as the canonical AOE source table
   - `EFFECT_TYPE_AREA_OF_EFFECT` evidence reinforces the pseudo-object lane but remains external effect-type evidence and emits `VFX_AOE_EFFECT_TYPE_OBJECT_CREATION_EXTERNAL` if used as recovered local runtime-body proof
   - creator/effect creator provenance is preserved and emits `VFX_AOE_CREATOR_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED` when unavailable for canonical runtime behavior
   - spell/caster metadata stored on AOE objects in EE remains profile evidence and emits `VFX_AOE_CREATOR_SPELL_METADATA_PROFILE_REQUIRED` if used without selected EE profile support
   - AOE shape/model-spawn/sound scheduling fields remain external/profile evidence and emit `VFX_AOE_SHAPE_SCHEMA_EXTERNAL`, `VFX_AOE_MODEL_SPAWN_SCHEMA_EXTERNAL`, or `VFX_AOE_SOUND_SCHEDULING_EXTERNAL` until retail/decompilation validation proves exact behavior
   - heartbeat cadence and exit-on-removal ordering emit `VFX_AOE_HEARTBEAT_CADENCE_EXTERNAL` / `VFX_AOE_ONEXIT_REMOVAL_EVENT_EXTERNAL` until a local runtime fixture proves exact timing
   - shape fields reused for both containment and random footprint limits emit `VFX_AOE_SHAPE_VISUAL_LIMITS_DUAL_USE_EXTERNAL` until canonical retail/decomp validation closes the math
   - `DurationVFX`, `MODEL01..MODEL03`, and AOE sound refs do not create a normal `AuroraVfxPhaseSchedule` without explicit AOE effect-instance context
   - `AuroraAoeRuntimeObject` is emitted only when a source row, `EffectAreaOfEffect` instance, static/mobile application context, and shape footprint are all present; missing inputs emit `VFX_AOE_RUNTIME_OBJECT_REQUIRED`, `VFX_AOE_EFFECT_INSTANCE_REQUIRED`, `VFX_AOE_STATIC_MOBILE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED`, or `VFX_AOE_SHAPE_FOOTPRINT_REQUIRED`
   - `DurationVFX`, `VisualFX`, `MODEL01..MODEL03`, model counts/durations/edge weights, and AOE sounds stay footprint refs and emit `VFX_AOE_DURATIONVFX_FOOTPRINT_NOT_PHASE`, `VFX_AOE_MODEL_FOOTPRINT_PROFILE_GATED`, or `VFX_AOE_SOUND_FOOTPRINT_PROFILE_GATED` if routed as ordinary phase slots
   - `SoundOneShot`/`SoundOneShotPercentage` and `MODELMIN01..MODELMIN03` stay AOE-profile fields and emit `VFX_AOE_SOUND_ONESHOT_PERCENTAGE_EXTERNAL` / `VFX_AOE_LOW_QUALITY_MODEL_PROFILE_GATED` if lowered into generic audio loops or low-quality `visualeffects.2da` fallbacks
   - selected-source AOE fixture preserves 47 physical rows, `C/R/****` shape distribution, circular fog rows, rectangular wall rows, `DurationVFX`-only rows such as `VFX_PER_WEB`, and mixed duration-visual/sound rows such as `VFX_PER_DARKNESS`; compaction, shape normalization, or phase-schedule promotion emits `VFX_AOE_SELECTED_ROW_SHAPE_PRESERVATION_REQUIRED`
   - selected-source AOE `SoundOneShotPercentage=0.3` remains a raw AOE footprint/scheduling cell and emits `VFX_AOE_SOUND_ONESHOT_PERCENTAGE_NOT_GENERIC_PROBABILITY` if reused as generic browser audio randomization without AOE context
   - OnEnter/Heartbeat/OnExit refs preserve resource class `script` and emit `VFX_AOE_SCRIPT_RESREF_CLASS_REQUIRED` if normalized into MDL, WAV, emitter, Geometry Nodes, or Three.js callback classes
   - AOE cache-key tests separate row ID, source profile/hash, static/mobile mode, anchor location or followed object, creator/effect creator, spell metadata, requested duration, shape footprint, event scripts, and visual/sound footprint refs; incomplete keys emit `VFX_AOE_CACHE_KEY_CONTEXT_REQUIRED`
   - preview admission requires source row plus effect instance plus shape footprint and emits `VFX_AOE_PREVIEW_ADMISSION_REQUIRED` when Blender/Three/POC data attempts to synthesize a canonical AOE object
   - normal `ApplyEffectAtLocation(EffectVisualEffect(...))` paths emit `VFX_AOE_NORMAL_LOCATION_VFX_NOT_AOE` if they attempt to enter the AOE lane
   - AOE lifecycle states are preserved as created/active/removed/expired/dispelled/destroyed-or-invalid-anchor evidence and emit `VFX_AOE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_REQUIRED` when the object lifecycle is collapsed into a persistent scene child
   - normal `ApplyEffectAtLocation` `EffectVisualEffect` paths cannot synthesize AOE persistence; only explicit `EffectAreaOfEffect` can enter the AOE lane
   - arbitrary `progfx.2da` references on AOE data emit `VFX_AOE_PROGFX_CROSS_TABLE_MISMATCH`
4. `iprp_visualfx.2da` separation.
   - loaded/available item-property visual effects are not merged into `visualeffects.2da`
   - item-property VFX diagnostics use the separate table name
   - `ModelSuffix`/weapon-glow style data stays separate from `Type_FD`, phases, and beam context
   - selected-source suffix fixture preserves raw table values `acid`, `frost`, `elect`, `fire`, `sonic`, `holy`, and `neg` separately from local hardcoded fallback literals `_fxacid`, `_fxfrost`, `_fxelect`, `_fxfire`, `_fxsonic`, `_fxholy`, and `_fxneg`
   - `ModelSuffix` table lookup is attempted before Aurora hardcoded fallback and records `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_TABLE_LOOKUP_PRECEDES_FALLBACK`
   - resolved suffix state records whether it came from `iprp_visualfx.2da` or from the Aurora fallback switch through `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_MODELSUFFIX_SOURCE_PROVENANCE`
   - selected-source `ModelSuffix` values emit `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_TABLE_SUFFIX_NOT_LITERAL_MODEL_RESREF` if a parser resolves them directly as MDL/model resrefs before item-property context and suffix-composition proof exist
   - known fallback suffix map preserves `0 -> _fxacid`, `1 -> _fxfrost`, `2 -> _fxelect`, `3 -> _fxfire`, `4 -> _fxsonic`, `5 -> _fxholy`, and `6 -> _fxneg`; missing or reordered entries emit `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_CONSTANT_SUFFIX_MAP_REQUIRED`
   - item visual constant labels remain external authoring labels and do not overwrite local suffix literals
   - `AuroraItemPropertyVisualFxSource.sourceKind` distinguishes table `ModelSuffix` rows from `iprp_damagecost` VFX-gated suffixes, `iprp_meleecost` VFX-gated suffixes, and other hardcoded item-property suffix paths
   - damage-cost visual suffix tests preserve the local selector mapping `6 -> _fxacid`, `7 -> _fxfrost`, `9 -> _fxelect`, `10 -> _fxfire`, and `13 -> _fxsonic`, and emit `VFX_IPRP_DAMAGECOST_SUFFIX_MAP_REQUIRED` if a table label or `iprp_visualfx` subtype rewrites those numeric selectors
   - `iprp_damagecost`/`iprp_meleecost` table-gate checks preserve table name, row/cost value, gate result, and local routine anchor; missing gate evidence emits `VFX_IPRP_DAMAGECOST_VFX_GATE_REQUIRED` or `VFX_IPRP_MELEECOST_VISUAL_GATE_REQUIRED`
   - `_fxholy`/`_fxneg` hardcoded item-property suffixes require property context and emit `VFX_ITEMPROP_HOLY_NEGATIVE_SUFFIX_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` if previewed from suffix text alone
   - cache keys include source kind and item-property context, not just suffix literal
   - missing `ModelSuffix` for known subtypes records Aurora hardcoded suffix fallback provenance and emits `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_HARDCODED_SUFFIX_FALLBACK`
   - missing `ModelSuffix` without a known fallback emits `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_MODELSUFFIX_REQUIRED`
   - unknown item-property visual subtypes emit `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_SUBTYPE_UNRESOLVED` without becoming `EffectVisualEffect`
   - canonical preview/admission requires item-property application context and emits `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_APPLICATION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` if only a subtype or suffix is available
   - melee/equipped weapon context is recorded before preview and emits `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_WEAPON_SLOT_REQUIRED` when missing or non-melee
   - subtype width/profile evidence is preserved and out-of-range custom rows emit `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_SUBTYPE_UINT8_PROFILE_REQUIRED`
   - `ModelSuffix` never becomes a `visualeffects.2da` phase model and emits `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_MODELSUFFIX_NOT_PHASE_MODEL` if routed through impact/duration/cessation scheduling
   - item-property `_fx*` suffix literals never become VFX placeable/source-list resrefs and emit `VFX_IPRP_SUFFIX_NOT_VFX_PLACEABLE_RESREF` or `VFX_ITEMPROP_SUFFIX_NOT_SOURCE_LIST_VFX_KIND` if routed through PoC `vfx_`/`fx_`/`plc_fx` palette heuristics, placed-object catalog identity, or direct MDL/model resolution before item-property context and suffix-composition proof exist
   - exact suffix-to-resource/model-name assembly remains unverified and emits `VFX_IPRP_VISUALFX_SUFFIX_COMPOSITION_UNVERIFIED` unless a retail fixture or recovered call-site proves it
4.1. `spells.2da` visual/projectile source separation.
   - spell rows preserve physical row ID, label/name, raw visual/projectile/script/sound cells, source layer, and schema/profile provenance
   - `ConjHeadVisual`, `ConjHandVisual`, `ConjGrndVisual`, `CastHeadVisual`, `CastHandVisual`, `CastGrndVisual`, and `ProjModel` preserve requested resource class and owner-column provenance
   - `Proj`, `ProjType`, `ProjSpwnPoint`, `ProjOrientation`, and `HasProjectile` remain projectile context and emit `VFX_SPELLS_PROJECTILE_SLOT_NOT_EMITTER` if routed through MDL emitter parsing
   - `ImpactScript`, `BardImpactScript`, and `MirvImpactScript` remain script refs and emit `VFX_SPELLS_IMPACT_SCRIPT_NOT_VFX_RESOURCE` if routed through model/VFX resource resolution
   - `ProjSound`, `ConjSoundVFX`, `CastSound`, and profile variants remain sound refs and emit `VFX_SPELLS_SOUND_SLOT_NOT_MODEL_RESOURCE` if treated as model refs
   - spell visual preview requires an `AuroraSpellVisualPresentationRequest` or equivalent and emits `VFX_SPELLS_PRESENTATION_REQUEST_REQUIRED` if only a row ID or source-slot string is available
   - projectile preview requires an `AuroraSpellProjectilePresentationRequest` or equivalent and emits `VFX_SPELL_PROJECTILE_PRESENTATION_REQUEST_REQUIRED` if only `ProjModel`, a projectile slot string, or a `progfx` row is available
   - a spell projectile presentation request is not a `progfx.2da` runtime request and emits `VFX_SPELL_PROJECTILE_NOT_PROGFX_REQUEST` if it is routed directly to `AuroraProgrammedFxRuntimeRequest` without an owning `visualeffects.2da` phase
   - fake-cast presentation requests preserve casting/projectile visuals but emit `VFX_SPELLS_FAKE_CAST_NO_IMPACT_SCRIPT` if they attempt to fire `ImpactScript` or synthesize script-created VFX
   - fake-cast bridge requests record a visual-only policy and emit `VFX_FAKE_SPELL_VISUAL_ONLY_POLICY_REQUIRED` when real-spell script execution is assumed from presentation visuals
   - projectile presentation does not prove script damage/impact timing and emits `VFX_SPELLS_PROJECTILE_VISUAL_NOT_SCRIPT_DAMAGE` when projectile travel is treated as damage synchronization
   - projectile path/orientation values from external `PROJECTILE_PATH_TYPE_*`/`ProjType` evidence remain profile-gated and emit `VFX_PROJECTILE_PATH_TYPE_EXTERNAL_PROFILE` until a selected runtime profile proves the mapping
   - projectile model refs never become emitter `chunkName` or per-particle spawned chunks and emit `VFX_PROJECTILE_MODEL_NOT_EMITTER_CHUNK` if routed through the emitter chunk lane
   - projectile spawn-point refs require caster/source anchor resolution and emit `VFX_PROJECTILE_SPAWNPOINT_ANCHOR_REQUIRED` when no caster model/anchor namespace is available
   - `IPRP_SPELLS`/`SpellIndex` rows remain item-property spell-use links and emit `VFX_SPELLS_IPRP_SPELLS_SEPARATE_TABLE` if treated as spell visual rows or VFX rows
   - item-property spell usage must preserve `SpellIndex`, usage flags, item context, and selected target `spells.2da` row; missing link context emits `VFX_SPELLS_SPELLINDEX_LINK_REQUIRED`
   - item-property spell usage emits `VFX_IPRP_SPELLINDEX_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` if a `SpellIndex` value is used without potion/wand/general-use context, item application context, and linked target spell-row provenance
   - `MirvImpactScript` emits `VFX_MIRV_IMPACT_SCRIPT_NOT_VISUAL_RESOURCE` if treated as a visual/model/progfx dependency instead of a script-policy/source-lane value
   - `progfx.2da` Type 10/11 bridge tests require linked spell context and emit `VFX_PROGFX_PROJECTILE_REQUIRES_SPELL_CONTEXT` when a spell-linked programmed row lacks a source spell row or projectile payload
   - Type 10/11 cache-key tests include linked spell/projectile/call-mode context and emit `VFX_PROGFX_PROJECTILE_CACHE_KEY_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` if only the programmed row and phase are keyed
   - `fxbeam` source slots emit `VFX_SPELLS_FXBEAM_NOT_EFFECT_BEAM` and legacy-compatible `VFX_SPELL_FXBEAM_SLOT_NOT_EFFECT_BEAM` unless explicit beam effect context supplies endpoints/body-node data
   - `conjurevisual`, `conjuregroundvisual`, `castvisual`, `castgroundvisual`, `fxground`, `fximpact`, `fxhead`, `fxfail`, `visfx`, `visualeffect`, `fx_light`, `light`, and `shadowblob` lower-case local strings emit `VFX_SPELLS_LOCAL_STRING_CLUSTER_NO_CALLSITE` when presented without owning-table/call-site evidence
   - `fx_light` / `light` local string evidence emits `VFX_SPELLS_FXLIGHT_NOT_PROGFX_TYPE4` if routed to `progfx.2da` Type 4, MDL `node light`, or generic renderer-light behavior without owning-table/runtime proof
   - `shadowblob` local string evidence emits `VFX_SPELLS_SHADOWBLOB_NOT_SHADOW_POLICY` if routed to PoC `shadow_proxy`, MDL light-shadow flags, hidden shadow meshes, or generic render-shadow policy without owning-table/runtime proof
   - `.sef`/`ProjSEF`-style cells preserve raw values and emit `VFX_SPELLS_SEF_PROFILE_MISMATCH` in Aurora/NWN1 profile
   - spell/toolset visual source slots round-trip without becoming `visualeffects.2da` phase columns, `ProgFX_*`, MDL emitter fields, or Blender particle settings
5. Effect-entry and attachment validation:
   - visual-effect row ID is preserved separately from application mode
   - constructed effect kind is preserved separately from both row ID and `Type_FD`
   - `EFFECT_TYPE_VISUALEFFECT` and `EFFECT_TYPE_BEAM` remain distinguishable when source data exposes them
   - local decompilation does not expose NWScript constructor symbols for `EffectVisualEffect`/`EffectBeam`; Lexicon/Beamdog-derived constructor fields carry external/profile provenance
   - xoreos NWN function table names/IDs for `GetEffectCreator`, `GetEffectType`, `EffectAreaOfEffect`, `EffectVisualEffect`, `EffectBeam`, `ApplyEffectAtLocation`, and `ApplyEffectToObject` are preserved as reverse-reference function-table evidence, but emit `VFX_XOREOS_NWSCRIPT_FUNCTION_TABLE_NAME_ONLY` when used as runtime-body proof
   - NWScript function IDs from reverse tables are preserved and emit `VFX_NWSCRIPT_FUNCTION_ID_PRESERVED`; they do not replace source row IDs, `visualeffects.2da` rows, or effect parameter indices
   - hardcoded engine VFX references preserve `engineEventProvenance` separately from `nwscriptFunctionProvenance` and emit `VFX_HARDCODED_VFX_REFERENCE_ENGINE_EVENT_REQUIRED` if only a row ID is stored
   - hardcoded VFX rows emit `VFX_HARDCODED_VFX_REFERENCE_NOT_NWSCRIPT_CONSTRUCTOR` if a caller treats the engine event as a scripted `EffectVisualEffect`/`EffectBeam` constructor body
   - hardcoded VFX rows require event-family/target/application context before canonical scheduling; row-only hardcoded use emits `VFX_HARDCODED_VFX_REFERENCE_ROW_CONTEXT_REQUIRED`
   - hardcoded direct MDL references, such as external monk-hit MDL examples, stay `hardcodedMdlReference` dependency edges and emit `VFX_HARDCODED_MDL_REFERENCE_NOT_VISUALEFFECTS_ROW` if converted into synthetic `visualeffects.2da` rows
   - hardcoded-reference tables from NWN Wiki are external/profile evidence and emit `VFX_HARDCODED_VFX_REFERENCE_SOURCE_PROFILE_REQUIRED` when used without selected build/profile provenance
   - hardcoded VFX effect-list visibility remains profile-gated and emits `VFX_HARDCODED_VFX_REFERENCE_GETEFFECT_VISIBILITY_GATED` until retail/decomp capture proves whether `GetFirstEffect`/`GetNextEffect` can observe the applied visual
   - `damagehitvisual.2da` / combat-damage behavior remains external/profile evidence and emits `VFX_DAMAGEHIT_TABLE_EXTERNAL_PROFILE_REQUIRED` until a selected retail/decomp profile proves the table and limits
   - selected-source `damagehitvisual.2da` fixture preserves 12 rows, blank physical rows `0..2`, exact `VisualEffectID` mapping for Magical/Acid/Cold/Divine/Electrical/Fire/Negative/Positive/Sonic, and all-blank `RangedEffectID`; parser compaction or ranged-lane synthesis emits `VFX_DAMAGEHIT_SELECTED_ROW_PRESERVATION_REQUIRED` / `VFX_DAMAGEHIT_RANGED_EFFECT_NOT_INFERRED_FROM_BLANK`
   - damage-hit preview requires event context and emits `VFX_DAMAGEHIT_EVENT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` if only a `VisualEffectID`, `RangedEffectID`, or damage row is available
   - damage-hit table rows emit `VFX_DAMAGEHIT_ROW_NOT_GENERIC_EFFECTVISUALEFFECT` if scheduled as plain scripted `EffectVisualEffect` without damage-event provenance
   - damage/combat VFX cache keys include damage type, melee/ranged lane, ammo/projectile, blood type/body size/petrified state, table profile, and event kind; incomplete keys emit `VFX_DAMAGEHIT_CACHE_KEY_CONTEXT_REQUIRED`
   - damage-hit effect-list visibility remains profile-gated and emits `VFX_DAMAGEHIT_EFFECT_LIST_VISIBILITY_GATED` until retail/decomp capture proves whether the visual is observable through effect iteration
   - local targeted decompilation absence of `damagehitvisual`/`damagetypes`/`ammunitiontypes` emits `VFX_DAMAGEHIT_TABLE_LOCAL_SYMBOL_ABSENT` when a caller presents the external table as local proof
   - local `blood` strings emit `VFX_COMBAT_BLOOD_STRING_NOT_DAMAGEHIT_CALLSITE` if treated as proof of the damage-hit or wounding/death application callsite
   - hardcoded combat chunk/gib events emit `VFX_COMBAT_CHUNK_EVENT_NOT_EMITTER_CHUNKNAME` if implemented through MDL emitter `chunkName` semantics instead of event provenance
   - direct combat MDL/progfx references stay outside `visualeffects.2da` row synthesis and emit `VFX_COMBAT_DIRECT_MDL_NOT_VFX_ROW` when collapsed into a fake VFX row
   - combat blood/chunk/death preview requires target appearance metadata and emits `VFX_COMBAT_TARGET_APPEARANCE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` when `BLOODCOLR`, current appearance, or size bucket is missing
   - `BLOODCOLR` interpretation remains selected-profile evidence and emits `VFX_COMBAT_BLOODCOLR_PROFILE_REQUIRED` until validated against the target runtime
   - `BLOODCOLR` values never become emitter `colorStart`/`colorEnd`, particle tint, material color, or Blender color fields; lane collapse emits `VFX_COMBAT_BLOODCOLR_NOT_EMITTER_COLOR`
   - `BLOODCOLR = N` is preserved as no-blood target metadata and emits `VFX_COMBAT_BLOODCOLR_NONE_PROFILE_GATED` until the skip/redirect/silent event policy is proven
   - combat chunk-size selection records appearance-derived creature size and emits `VFX_COMBAT_CREATURE_SIZE_SOURCE_REQUIRED` when it uses target mesh bounds, Blender scale, or blueprint race instead
   - `creaturesize.2da` rows stay toolset/name evidence and emit `VFX_COMBAT_CREATURESIZE_TABLE_TOOLSET_ONLY` if treated as an extensible runtime size table
   - `SIZECATEGORY`/`CREATURE_SIZE_*` is not model scale; chunk selection based on mesh scale emits `VFX_COMBAT_SIZECATEGORY_NOT_MODEL_SCALE`
   - `BodyBag`/`bodybag.2da` rows stay corpse/remains-placeable lifecycle evidence and emit `VFX_COMBAT_BODYBAG_NOT_VFX_PHASE` if routed through impact/duration/cessation scheduling
   - lootable-corpse vs bodybag behavior remains profile-gated and emits `VFX_COMBAT_BODYBAG_LOOTABLE_POLICY_PROFILE_GATED` until selected runtime behavior is proven
   - local `Appearance`/`BodyBag`/`CreatureSize` GFF/table strings emit `VFX_COMBAT_APPEARANCE_GFF_LOCAL_EVIDENCE_ONLY` if used as proof of the hardcoded damage/death VFX callsite
   - combat target metadata is not the damage event itself and emits `VFX_COMBAT_TARGET_METADATA_NOT_DAMAGE_EVENT` if stored without `AuroraCombatVfxEventProvenance`
   - combat cache keys include target appearance/blood/size/bodybag policy and emit `VFX_COMBAT_APPEARANCE_CACHE_KEY_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` when they only include row ID or damage type
   - polymorph/appearance changes require current runtime appearance context and emit `VFX_COMBAT_POLYMORPHED_APPEARANCE_RUNTIME_REQUIRED` if original blueprint/race appearance is reused for combat VFX selection
   - PoC `chunkName` parser/runtime behavior emits `VFX_POC_CHUNKNAME_NOT_HARDCODED_COMBAT_CHUNK` if used as proof of spectacular-death combat chunk selection
   - effect-instance constructor fields derived from Lexicon, Beamdog notes, or runtime observation emit/record `VFX_EFFECT_ENTRY_EXTERNAL_SOURCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED` until a local decompilation branch or retail fixture proves the exact selected profile behavior
   - `GetEffectInteger`/`GetEffectFloat`/`GetEffectVector`/`GetEffectObject` observation slots emit `VFX_GETEFFECT_ACCESSOR_EE_PROFILE_GATED` outside a selected EE/runtime-observation profile
   - `GetEffectObject` beam object-index mapping emits `VFX_GETEFFECT_OBJECT_BEAM_INDEX_UNVERIFIED` until a scripted retail fixture or recovered body proves the exact index for effector/source/target
   - `GetEffectType` broad/all-types access emits `VFX_GETEFFECT_TYPE_ALLTYPES_PROFILE_GATED` unless the selected runtime profile supports it
   - `GetEffectCreator` results emit `VFX_EFFECT_CREATOR_DECLARER_NOT_APPLIER` if a caller tries to treat creator as applying object, beam effector, or target
   - object/location/beam application modes stay distinguishable
   - requested duration and duration type are preserved before renderer scheduling
   - `Type_FD = F` and `Type_FD = P` with temporary/permanent application emit duration-coercion diagnostics
   - `Type_FD = D` and `Type_FD = B` remain duration candidates instead of being collapsed to instant preview
   - `ApplyEffectAtLocation` is not persisted as an area-owned duration visual by default
   - `ApplyEffectAtLocation` produces `VFX_EFFECT_APPLY_LOCATION_FORCED_INSTANT` when a caller attempts duration scheduling through it
   - normal instant VFX application produces `VFX_EFFECT_INSTANT_NOT_SCENE_CHILD` if a renderer/export path tries to persist it as a scene object
   - `ApplyEffectAtLocation` forced-instant logic is scoped to normal `EffectVisualEffect` VFX; AOE/summon/swarm effects require their own effect-family contracts
   - explicit `EffectAreaOfEffect` construction enters the AOE lane and preserves `vfx_persistent.2da` row ID, event scripts, static/mobile application mode, and pseudo-object context
   - AOE script constructor overrides preserve table-default versus override provenance and never mutate the source row
   - mobile AOE and static AOE fixtures preserve different observability/removal behavior before renderer preview
   - `EffectAreaOfEffect` row IDs never share `EffectVisualEffect`/`visualeffects.2da` cache keys, even when the AOE row references a duration visual footprint
   - `DurationVFX` or `MODEL01..MODEL03` inside an AOE row cannot be used to bypass the AOE effect/object contract
   - AOE event scripts remain script refs and are not resource-resolved as MDL emitters, textures, sounds, or Blender data-blocks
   - visual-only `EffectLinkEffects` combinations emit `VFX_EFFECT_LINK_VISUAL_ONLY_UNRELIABLE` instead of becoming reliable duration VFX
   - visual-only `EffectLinkEffects` is not duration proof for a VFX row, even when the row itself has duration-capable `Type_FD`
   - phase schedule tests prove that row parsing, effect construction, and effect application are three separate steps
   - location-applied normal visual effects emit event-style scheduling diagnostics unless an explicit persistent/AOE effect path is present
   - object-applied instant visual effects are not persisted as scene children
   - object-applied temporary/permanent duration effects require target usability and row `Type_FD` support before canonical scheduling
   - duration schedules include distinct apply/active/remove phase refs and keep sounds/programmed FX separate from model refs
   - duplicate row ID/transform refresh behavior remains retail-validation-gated and emits `VFX_PHASE_DURATION_DEDUP_UNVERIFIED` / `VFX_PHASE_TRANSFORM_REFRESH_DELAY_REQUIRED`
   - `nMissEffect`/`bMissEffect` is preserved and duration-miss combinations emit diagnostics
   - `nMissEffect`/`bMissEffect` stays an effect-instance/application field and emits `VFX_EFFECT_MISS_NOT_EMITTER_RANDOMNESS` if mapped to emitter `randvel`/`spread`/`velocity`, spawn jitter, PoC random offsets, Blender particle randomness, or frontend sprite drift
   - duration miss behavior emits `VFX_EFFECT_MISS_DURATION_POLICY_UNVERIFIED` until a retail/decomp fixture proves stable selected-profile behavior
   - `EffectVisualEffect` observation slots preserve row ID, miss flag, scale, translate, and rotate
   - `EffectVisualEffect` scale/translate/rotate are NWN:EE profile-gated and do not exist as classic Aurora source fields unless a selected profile or script constructor supplies them
   - local `CAurObjectVisualTransformData` / `ObjectVisualTransformData` evidence remains an object-presentation lane and emits `VFX_OBJECT_VISUAL_TRANSFORM_NOT_EFFECT_TRANSFORM` if used as `EffectVisualEffect`/`EffectBeam` `fScale`/`vTranslate`/`vRotate` proof
   - PoC `VisualTransform` fixtures from `VisTransformList` / `VisualTransform`, `_visual_transform_matrix`, `_placeable_model_matrix`, and emitter `world_matrix` application keep object-presentation context separate from row orientation flags and EE effect transform tuple
   - PoC/object visual transforms emit `VFX_POC_VISUAL_TRANSFORM_NOT_VFX_ORIENTATION_FLAG` or `VFX_OBJECT_VISUAL_TRANSFORM_NOT_ROW_ORIENT_POLICY` if used to create, fill, cache-key-collapse, or mutate `OrientWithObject`, `OrientWithGround`, `InheritScale`, `BodyNode`, or `fScale` / `vTranslate` / `vRotate`
   - `EffectVisualEffect`/`EffectBeam`/`ApplyEffect*`/`GetEffect*`/`BODY_NODE_*`/`EFFECT_TYPE_*` local symbol absence is recorded before relying on external slot mapping
   - `EffectVisualEffect` `GetEffect*` parameter-index mapping remains external/retail-observation evidence until local runtime bodies are recovered
   - duplicate same-row duration VFX and transformed remove/reapply behavior are retail validation fixtures, not parser facts
   - EE `fScale`, `vTranslate`, and `vRotate` stay on the effect instance and are profile-gated
   - renderer payloads expose an explicit transform stack with separate target/location anchor, row/phase/root attachment, EE effect transform, source MDL node animation transform, emitter runtime transform, and per-particle basis layers
   - EE `fScale` emits `VFX_EFFECT_TRANSFORM_NOT_PARTICLE_SIZE` if used as `sizeStart/sizeEnd`, chunk particle size, MDL node `scale`, or Blender object scale
   - EE `vTranslate` emits `VFX_EFFECT_TRANSFORM_NOT_MDL_SOURCE` if baked into MDL `position`, emitter `xsize/ysize`, P2P target offsets, or Blender object location
   - EE `vRotate` emits `VFX_EFFECT_TRANSFORM_NOT_EMITTER_BASIS` if used to rewrite emitter `render` billboarding, `particleRot`, MDL `orientationkey`, row orientation flags, or Blender particle rotation
   - effect transform order/axis retail parity remains diagnostic through `VFX_EFFECT_TRANSFORM_ORDER_RETAIL_UNVERIFIED` until a runtime fixture proves matrix order and rotation-vector convention
   - object visual transforms stay separate from real object position/pathing and emit `VFX_OBJECT_VISUAL_TRANSFORM_REAL_POSITION_UNCHANGED` if a preview uses visual translation as saved object coordinates, beam endpoint identity, AOE footprint position, or attachment namespace proof
   - object visual-transform lerp/current-value behavior is profile/client-state evidence and emits `VFX_OBJECT_VISUAL_TRANSFORM_LERP_PROFILE_GATED` until a selected runtime fixture proves current-lerp behavior
   - cache keys that include target object visual transforms keep a separate object-transform hash/scope/lerp component; folding it into the VFX effect tuple emits `VFX_OBJECT_VISUAL_TRANSFORM_CACHE_KEY_REQUIRED`
   - `effectCreatorRef` is preserved as provenance and never dropped from duration/link fixtures, while still not replacing `EffectBeam` `oEffector`
   - object-attached VFX requires target-usability/context diagnostics before a row is treated as canonical object-attached runtime state
   - duplicate visual-effect rows with different effect transforms do not share one stale cache entry
   - effect-instance cache keys include row ID, source file/version, effect kind, application mode, phase, target/attachment class, transform, miss flag, and beam source/body-node context
   - duration scheduling requires effect context and produces `VFX_EFFECT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED_FOR_DURATION` when only the row is available
   - effect creator is preserved only as provenance and never substituted for `EffectBeam` `oEffector`
   - missing beam `oEffector` produces `VFX_BEAM_EFFECTOR_REQUIRED` instead of falling back to creator, target, or applying object
   - explicit `EffectBeam` rendering requires an `AuroraVfxBeamContext` and produces `VFX_BEAM_CONTEXT_RECORD_REQUIRED` when row-only, `Type_FD`-only, shader-only, mesh-only, or spell-slot-only evidence is used
   - explicit beam cache keys include row/source profile, constructed effect kind, source object, target context, body node, miss flag, duration/application mode, EE transform tuple/profile, and explicit-vs-implicit policy; row-only beam caches emit `VFX_BEAM_CACHE_KEY_CONTEXT_REQUIRED`
   - `EffectBeam` `oEffector` remains the beam source and produces `VFX_BEAM_EFFECTOR_NOT_CREATOR` if substituted with `GetEffectCreator` provenance
   - `Type_FD = B` rows applied through generic `EffectVisualEffect` preserve an implicit-beam-context-unverified state and do not share cache/context with explicit `EffectBeam`
   - generic `EffectVisualEffect` beam rows emit `VFX_BEAM_EFFECTVISUALEFFECT_IMPLICIT_ONLY` if treated as explicit `EffectBeam`
   - `Type_FD = B`, `VFX_BEAM_*`, or `progfx.2da` Type 7 evidence emits `VFX_BEAM_ROW_TYPE_NOT_CONTEXT` if used as endpoint/source/body-node context
   - EE `EffectBeam` scale/translate/rotate slots emit `VFX_BEAM_TRANSFORM_PROFILE_REQUIRED` outside a selected EE/API profile
   - `GetEffectObject` beam index captures emit `VFX_BEAM_GETEFFECT_OBJECT_MAPPING_OBSERVATION_ONLY` until retail or recovered-body evidence proves exact index meaning
   - explicit beam fixtures preserve `AuroraBeamAnchorLifecycleTrace`; row-only duration or geometry-only replay emits `VFX_BEAM_ANCHOR_LIFECYCLE_REQUIRED` and `VFX_BEAM_ROW_ONLY_DURATION_FORBIDDEN`
   - current `workspacePlaceableModelPresentation.ts` beam-like regex/profile scaffolds emit `VFX_CURRENT_FRONTEND_BEAM_SCAFFOLD_PREVIEW_ONLY` / `VFX_FRONTEND_BEAM_REGEX_NOT_EFFECTBEAM` if used as `EffectBeam`, `Type_FD = B`, `VFX_BEAM_*`, or `progfx.2da` Type 7 proof
   - source/target death or destruction handling is selected-profile evidence and emits `VFX_BEAM_SOURCE_DEATH_POLICY_PROFILE_GATED` or `VFX_BEAM_TARGET_INVALIDATION_POLICY_UNVERIFIED` until retail fixtures prove classic/EE behavior
   - missing body-node lookup during an active beam emits `VFX_BEAM_BODY_NODE_LIFECYCLE_REQUIRED` instead of silently moving the endpoint to object origin
   - attachment resolution requires target class and attachment namespace before selecting a node
   - attachment resolution uses an `AuroraVfxAttachmentRequest`/resolved-anchor style structure and emits `VFX_ATTACHMENT_REQUEST_STRUCT_REQUIRED` if reduced to an untyped node string
   - attachment namespaces are an enum-style contract; phase slots, `visualeffects.2da` `BodyNode`, beam `BODY_NODE_*`, ProgFX Type 12 target nodes, placeable/door special nodes, creature-unverified nodes, AOE footprint anchors, and spell/toolset source slots stay separate
   - selected empty phase slots, missing phase model resources, and missing target attachment nodes emit distinct diagnostics (`VFX_ATTACHMENT_SELECTED_SLOT_EMPTY_NOT_NODE_MISS`, `VFX_ATTACHMENT_PHASE_MODEL_MISS_NOT_NODE_MISS`, `VFX_ATTACHMENT_MISSING_NODE_DIAGNOSTIC`)
   - location-applied normal VFX emits `VFX_ATTACHMENT_LOCATION_ONLY_NO_NODE_NAMESPACE` when a caller attempts `HeadCon`, `Root_*`, `BodyNode`, or special-node resolution without a target model
   - orientation row flags remain an attachment/spawned-model transform policy and emit `VFX_ATTACHMENT_ORIENTATION_POLICY_SEPARATE` if used to change emitter billboard/render behavior
   - placeable/door special-node prefix rules are accepted only with external-source provenance and profile diagnostics
   - missing placeable/door special nodes record explicit center-fallback provenance rather than hiding the fallback
   - placeable/door center fallback is scoped to the documented special-node convention and emits `VFX_ATTACHMENT_CENTER_FALLBACK_SCOPE_REQUIRED` / `VFX_ATTACHMENT_CENTER_FALLBACK_NOT_GLOBAL` if applied to beams, creatures, ProgFX model nodes, phase resource misses, or sound-only rows
   - creature special-node attachment emits runtime-unverified diagnostics until retail/decompilation evidence proves the lookup path
   - phase slots, placeable/door special dummies, beam `BODY_NODE_*`, and creature `BodyPart_*` stay separate namespaces
   - external `BODY_NODE_*` values are preserved as source anchors without guessing missing model nodes
   - beam source object, target context, `nBodyPart`, and beam body-node anchor are preserved
   - beam `BODY_NODE_*` namespace is not merged with creature appearance `BodyPart_*`/`CREATURE_PART_*`
   - local creature GFF `BodyPart_*` fields produce `VFX_BEAM_BODY_NODE_NOT_CRE_BODY_PART` if used as beam-anchor evidence
   - local `m_bOrientWithTarget` string evidence produces `VFX_BEAM_ORIENT_WITH_TARGET_STRING_ONLY` until a visible runtime branch or retail fixture proves how the flag changes beam orientation
   - local `vs_beamvol`/`fs_beamvol` shader strings prove a beam-volume render lane exists, but produce `VFX_BEAM_VOLUME_SHADER_NOT_EFFECT_CONTEXT` if used as source/target/body-node evidence
   - mesh/material `beaming` produces `VFX_MESH_BEAMING_NOT_EFFECT_BEAM` if used as runtime beam-constructor evidence
   - xoreos/NWN model parser evidence keeps `beaming` on `ModelNode::Mesh`; importer fixtures preserve it as mesh/node metadata and emit `VFX_MESH_BEAMING_NOT_EFFECT_BEAM` if it creates `AuroraVfxEffectInstance.effectKind = beam`
   - attached-VFX cache keys include resolved-anchor provenance and emit `VFX_ATTACHMENT_CACHE_KEY_ANCHOR_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED` if only row ID and target object ID are used
   - spell/toolset `fxbeam` source slots produce `VFX_SPELL_FXBEAM_SLOT_NOT_EFFECT_BEAM` unless resolved through the owning table and effect application context
   - spell/toolset `projectile`/`visfx`/`visualeffect`/`fx*`/`conjurevisual`/`castvisual` slots remain upstream source-slot metadata until the owning table row is resolved
   - unresolved beam source/body-node data emits diagnostics without synthesizing endpoints
   - `EffectBeam`/beam-family rows are not interpreted as emitter `render Beam`
   - beam rows applied through generic `EffectVisualEffect` are diagnosed instead of silently upgraded to `EffectBeam`
6. MDL emitter field parser:
   - known fields
   - unknown fields
   - `fieldkey`
   - `fieldbezierkey`
   - direct orientation axis-angle conversion preservation
   - counted key lists
   - `endlist`-terminated key lists
   - bezier-key component count mapping `(parsedFloatCount - 1) / 3`
   - 12-byte runtime track metadata records preserve target field offset, key count, time-pool offset, value-pool offset, component type, and Bezier flag
   - scalar animated fields clamp before/after key range and linearly interpolate normal `fieldkey` rows
   - vector and quaternion/orientation animated fields use Aurora evaluator paths, not Blender F-Curve evaluation
   - Bezier-marked animated fields preserve runtime-evaluator provenance and emit evaluator diagnostics until helper semantics are fixture-validated
   - `fieldbezierkey` raw rows preserve their physical token, raw row text, parsed `time + three floats per component` payload, target offset, and Bezier metadata flag; loss emits `VFX_ANIM_BEZIERKEY_ROW_PAYLOAD_PRESERVED`
   - Blender Bezier interpolation/handle data cannot satisfy Aurora `fieldbezierkey` preservation and emits `VFX_BLENDER_FCURVE_BEZIER_NOT_AURORA_BEZIERKEY` if promoted to canonical evaluator or source payload
   - NeverBlender-style export that evaluates Blender F-Curves at keyed frames and writes ordinary `fieldkey` lists emits `VFX_NEVERBLENDER_EXPORT_SAMPLES_FCURVES_TO_FIELDKEY_ONLY` if used as proof of preserved Aurora `fieldbezierkey`
   - exporting a new Aurora `fieldbezierkey` from Blender F-Curve handles requires a conversion/admission record; missing evidence emits `VFX_ANIM_BEZIERKEY_IMPORT_EXPORT_ADMISSION_REQUIRED`
   - P2P `p2p_bezier2`/`p2p_bezier3` source/target handles stay emitter scalar fields and emit `VFX_P2P_BEZIER_HANDLE_NOT_FCURVE_HANDLE` if mapped from Blender F-Curve handle coordinates
   - model-layer animation evaluation applies metadata records through `targetObject + targetOffset` before emitter update/render
   - render/update tests fail if a renderer evaluates tracks ad hoc instead of consuming post-evaluation source/runtime fields
   - an `AuroraVfxTickTrace`-style record exposes source snapshot, evaluated snapshot, event scan, event callbacks, family update, post-update state, and render input; missing trace emits `VFX_ANIM_TICK_ORDER_TRACE_REQUIRED`
   - `event <time> detonate` callbacks set per-emitter Explosion latch state before family update; doing it after update emits `VFX_ANIM_EVENT_CALLBACK_BEFORE_EMITTER_UPDATE`
   - `detonate` event rows are model-scope animation events and preserve unknown event names; treating them as node-local strings emits `VFX_ANIM_EVENT_MODEL_SCOPE_REQUIRED` or `VFX_ANIM_EVENT_UNKNOWN_NAME_PRESERVED`
   - Blender event frame conversion remains authoring metadata and emits `VFX_ANIM_EVENT_FRAME_CONVERSION_NON_CANONICAL` if used as canonical event timing without Aurora seconds/provenance
   - Blender timeline markers may carry authoring names, but mapping them directly to detonate callbacks emits `VFX_BLENDER_MARKER_NOT_DETONATE_CALLBACK` unless Aurora event seconds/source-row provenance exists
   - transition/blend weight changes scalar/vector/quaternion writes through the Aurora blend equation, not through Blender interpolation
   - physical track-token preservation emits `VFX_ANIM_PHYSICAL_TRACK_TOKEN_PRESERVED` when a normalized parser drops the original `field`/`fieldkey`/`fieldbezierkey` token text, and `VFX_ANIM_KEY_BEZIER_TOKEN_COLLAPSED` when normal-key and Bezier-key rows are merged into one untyped key list
   - event/key-crossing callbacks are scanned in the same pass as animated-track application, with `detonate` preserved for Explosion emitters
   - Explosion update consumes a per-emitter detonate latch, one-shot guard, and requested spawn count; tests assert `VFX_EXPLOSION_DETONATE_LATCH_PER_EMITTER_REQUIRED`, `VFX_EXPLOSION_DETONATE_ONE_SHOT_GUARD_REQUIRED`, `VFX_EXPLOSION_SPAWN_COUNT_NONZERO_GATE_REQUIRED`, and `VFX_EXPLOSION_BIRTHRATE_ZERO_GATE_REQUIRED`
   - detonate event rows and direct/key/bezier `detonate` tracks are separate lanes even though they share target/runtime offset `0xe4`; collapsing them emits `VFX_DETONATE_EVENT_FIELD_SEPARATION_REQUIRED`
   - latch-active plus zero requested spawn count records `VFX_EXPLOSION_LATCH_PLUS_ZERO_COUNT_NO_BURST` if a renderer creates particles or blast anyway
   - duplicate detonate callbacks are preserved as callback evidence, but treating the byte latch as an additive burst counter emits `VFX_EXPLOSION_DUPLICATE_CALLBACK_BYTE_LATCH_NOT_COUNTER`
   - Explosion update clears the detonate latch after the tick and records `VFX_EXPLOSION_DETONATE_LATCH_CLEAR_REQUIRED` if the latch can leak into the next frame
   - Blender particle emission start/end/count/lifetime cannot replace `event <time> detonate`; such mapping emits `VFX_EXPLOSION_EVENT_NOT_BLENDER_EMISSION_RANGE`
   - PoC `detonateEvents` cycle replay and density-scaled burst count remain preview-only and emit `VFX_POC_EXPLOSION_EVENT_CYCLE_PREVIEW_ONLY` or `VFX_POC_EXPLOSION_DENSITY_BURST_PREVIEW_ONLY` if promoted to canonical runtime
   - missing `event <time> detonate` keeps Explosion silent and emits `VFX_EXPLOSION_NO_DETONATE_NO_FALLBACK_BURST` if a renderer/viewer creates a periodic fallback burst
   - PoC/debug fallback intervals such as `fallbackBurstInterval` remain explicitly non-canonical and emit `VFX_POC_EXPLOSION_FALLBACK_BURST_PREVIEW_ONLY` if exposed outside a labelled preview/debug lane
   - update-family mutation and render-input generation stay separate; render-time particle creation emits `VFX_ANIM_UPDATE_RENDER_SEPARATION_REQUIRED`
   - atlas `fps`, `frameStart`, and `frameEnd` are evaluated scalar target fields before renderer atlas playback
   - source live-read fields such as `xgrid`, `ygrid`, and `twosidedtex` are read after the animation evaluation pass
   - boolean/flag-mask fields such as `affectedByWind`, `m_isTinted`, `bounce`, `random`, `inherit*`, `splat`, and `p2p_sel`
   - mid-point families omitted by NeverBlender, such as `colorMid`, `percent*`, `alphaMid`, `sizeMid`, and `sizeMid_y`
   - `renderorder` raw row plus normalized signed-short value, with draw-item tie-breaker provenance, authoring-minimum provenance, and no direct global-object-order substitution
   - NWmax/case-variant fixtures preserve physical token names such as `spawnType`, `xSize`, `ySize`, `Blend`, `Splat`, `Drag`, and `lightningSubDiv` while mapping only profile-admitted aliases to canonical Aurora fields
   - `*_sel` helper tokens such as `spawntype_sel`, `update_sel`, `render_sel`, and `blend_sel` are recorded as authoring metadata and do not override canonical Aurora source tokens when both are present
   - unknown helper tokens survive raw round trip and emit `VFX_PARSER_UNKNOWN_HELPER_TOKEN_PRESERVED` instead of being silently dropped or promoted to runtime fields
   - Motion_Blur `opacity` fixtures preserve the physical source token, keep `rawOpacityToken` separate from `alphaStart`/`alphaEnd`, and emit `VFX_MOTION_BLUR_OPACITY_LOCAL_TOKEN_UNRECOVERED` until a selected source profile proves the local runtime/parser mapping
6.1. Runtime constructor/init validation:
   - source-node pointer/reference is preserved separately from runtime state
   - common Aurora constructor defaults initialize runtime lists, transform caches, identity quaternion/vector slots, helper pointers, and sentinel bytes before family-specific setup
   - source-emitter constructor defaults preserve an empty `chunkName` buffer, `spawntype = 0`, `twosidedtex = 0`, source flag mask `0`, and short `renderorder = 0` from Aurora evidence
   - missing or zero `xgrid/ygrid` stays raw/unset in source state while renderer-effective grid state becomes `1` only at the textured-particle renderer boundary
   - `xsize` and `ysize` direct/key/bezier-key rows preserve target offsets `0xc4` and `0xc8`, evaluated runtime values, and authoring-unit provenance
   - point emitters copy runtime emitter origin directly and emit `VFX_EMITTER_SPAWN_RECTANGLE_POINT_ORIGIN_REQUIRED` if routed through random rectangle sampling
   - non-point emitters use Aurora integer/sign spawn-rectangle sampling through runtime basis vectors and emit `VFX_EMITTER_SPAWN_RECTANGLE_INTEGER_SIGN_SAMPLER_REQUIRED` / `VFX_EMITTER_SPAWN_RECTANGLE_RUNTIME_BASIS_REQUIRED` if replaced by continuous world-axis sampling
   - dimensions below the inspected runtime spawn threshold emit `VFX_EMITTER_SPAWN_RECTANGLE_LT4_AXIS_GATE` if a preview tries to treat them as a continuous rectangle
   - `velocity`, `randvel`, `spread`, and `particleRot` direct/key/bezier-key rows preserve target offsets `0xc0`, `0xa4`, `0xb8`, and `0xa0`, plus evaluated runtime values and parser-family provenance, emitting `VFX_EMITTER_MOTION_TARGET_OFFSETS_REQUIRED` if collapsed into Blender-native settings only
   - `particleRot` source/evaluated payloads preserve raw authoring value, parser family, selected unit profile, Blender shim value, and runtime angular-speed slot; missing unit provenance emits `VFX_PARTICLEROT_UNIT_PROFILE_REQUIRED`
   - active-particle update fixtures advance stored `particle +0x14` by evaluated runtime slot `+0xa0 * delta` and emit `VFX_PARTICLEROT_STATE_ADVANCE_REQUIRED` if rotation is computed only at render time from particle age
   - rotation wrap fixtures preserve Aurora's `+/- 2*pi` state bound and emit `VFX_PARTICLEROT_WRAP_REQUIRED` if the state is left unbounded or replaced by an unproven modulo policy
   - source-emitter flag word `+0x144` preserves inherit-family bits `inherit = 0x40`, `inheritvel = 0x80`, `inherit_local = 0x100`, and `inherit_part = 0x400`
   - particle reset treats `inheritvel`, `spread`, and `randvel` as Aurora reset/runtime paths: `inheritvel` calls the reset helper, non-zero `spread` calls the runtime randomization helper, and `randvel` contributes only through the inspected `0.01`-gated signed random speed term
   - `inheritvel` fixtures preserve separate inherited-motion state at `particle +0x18/+0x1c/+0x20/+0x24` and emit `VFX_EMITTER_INHERITVEL_SEPARATE_STATE_REQUIRED` if it is merged into normal velocity slots `+0x50/+0x54/+0x58`
   - `inheritvel` reset fixtures verify helper order before spread/final velocity derivation and emit `VFX_EMITTER_INHERITVEL_RESET_ORDER_REQUIRED` if a renderer computes final velocity first
   - non-positive reset-delta fixtures preserve the helper's `0.01` scalar fallback and emit `VFX_EMITTER_INHERITVEL_DELTA_FALLBACK_REQUIRED` if the fallback is replaced by `1/delta`, zero, or Blender object-velocity behavior
   - `position`/`orientation`/`scale` direct, key, and bezier-key base-node tracks, `inheritcolor`, and `parent` are preserved before emitter inheritance flags are interpreted
   - `AuroraEmitterTransformContext` records source node path, MDL parent chain, evaluated runtime basis, current origin, previous origin, delta, source flag word, and effect-attachment layer before any inherit-family reset/update branch runs
   - `inheritvel` fixtures must carry previous/current emitter transform provenance; a current-frame `matrixWorld` or PoC `worldMatrixRowMajor` basis emits `VFX_EMITTER_INHERITVEL_PREVIOUS_TRANSFORM_REQUIRED` and `VFX_EMITTER_BASIS_NOT_POC_WORLDMATRIX`
   - active update fixtures verify inherited-motion displacement and magnitude decay, emitting `VFX_EMITTER_INHERITVEL_ACTIVE_UPDATE_DECAY_REQUIRED` if inherited state is not applied after reset
   - active update fixtures verify `inherit` reprojection through cached emitter frames and emit `VFX_EMITTER_INHERIT_ACTIVE_REPROJECT_REQUIRED` if only current world position/matrix is used
   - moving-parent fixtures verify `inherit_local` and `inherit_part` require parent-frame provenance and emit `VFX_EMITTER_INHERIT_LOCAL_PARENT_FRAME_REQUIRED` or `VFX_EMITTER_INHERIT_PART_PARENT_FRAME_REQUIRED` if runtime `+0x40` context is absent
   - `inherit_local`, `inherit_part`, and `inheritcolor` stay separate from Blender object space, child-particle systems, and tint/color fields
   - Blender `ParticleSettings.normal_factor`, `factor_random`, and `angular_velocity_factor` are accepted only as NeverBlender authoring shims for `velocity`, `randvel`, and `particleRot`; they do not prove Aurora runtime velocity, spread, or inheritance behavior
   - Blender `ParticleSettings.angular_velocity_factor`, `angular_velocity_mode`, rotation phase/randomness, dynamic rotation, and orientation-axis controls emit `VFX_BLENDER_ANGULAR_VELOCITY_NOT_AURORA_PARTICLEROT` if used as canonical `particleRot` units or update-state proof
   - PoC `particleRot` degree/radian heuristic and age-only render-time spin emit `VFX_POC_PARTICLEROT_DEGREE_HEURISTIC_PREVIEW_ONLY` or `VFX_POC_PARTICLEROT_AGE_ONLY_PREVIEW_ONLY` when promoted to Aurora parity
   - Blender object `matrix_world`, particle `object_align_factor`/`object_factor`, object velocity, and 2DA `InheritScale` are adapter/profile facts only and never satisfy MDL emitter inheritance parity by themselves; object-velocity promotion emits `VFX_BLENDER_OBJECT_VELOCITY_NOT_AURORA_INHERITVEL`
   - PoC `VisualTransform` / `world_matrix` and Three/Blender `matrixWorld` / `matrix_world` are preview or target-presentation matrices only. They do not prove `OrientWithObject`, `OrientWithGround`, `InheritScale`, or emitter inheritance parity; promotion emits `VFX_BLENDER_MATRIXWORLD_NOT_ORIENTWITHOBJECT_PROOF`
   - `spawntype` preserves source offset `0x84` and constructor default `0`; `birthrate` direct/key/bezier-key rows preserve target offset `0x58` and feed the post-evaluation Fountain spawn gate
   - Fountain normal mode preserves runtime accumulator `+0x16c`, threshold `1 / birthrate`, and zero-reset behavior after a spawn burst
   - Fountain trail mode preserves residual vector slots `+0x138/+0x13c/+0x140`, computes movement from current/previous emitter positions, spaces particles by `1 / birthrate`, and clears residual state when the positive-rate gate is false
   - `lifeExp`, `lifeExpkey`, and `lifeExpbezierkey` preserve parser target offset `0x90`; direct/key/bezier-key variants feed the same evaluated runtime lifetime slot
   - active lifetime fixtures preserve the Aurora update order: lifetime gate against `particle +0x6c` first, active-list removal/free-list append on expiry, then age increment and negative-age clamp only for survivors
   - `Single` preserves source `loop` at source offset `+0x13c`, parser target evidence for `loop`, and source-constructor default `0`
   - `Single` preserves `lifeExp`/`lifeExpkey`/`lifeExpbezierkey` as target offset `0x90`, with Blender/NeverBlender `lifeexp` treated as authoring source for that Aurora field only
   - NeverBlender `loop` export is accepted as Single authoring evidence only; it does not enable Blender particle looping, Fountain reuse, or a preview-only persistent sprite path
   - NeverBlender `xgrid/ygrid default=1`, `renderorder default=0`, and texture UI defaults are accepted only as authoring defaults; they do not overwrite raw Aurora source-constructor provenance
   - importing a source emitter with omitted `chunkName` never converts it into a texture fallback or chunk fallback without an explicit source field
   - Fountain, Explosion, Single, and Lightning-compatible constructors all share the common constructor before installing family-specific behavior
   - render/blend mapping runs after family construction and records source token, mapped enum, fallback bucket, and function-table/helper provenance
   - `xgrid`, `ygrid`, and `twosidedtex` remain source-field live reads in the textured-particle renderer
   - zero evaluated runtime lifetime/scale gate produces no textured draw and emits `VFX_RUNTIME_LIFEEXP_ZERO_DRAW_GATE` when imported data would otherwise try to render
   - preview-only `lifeExp` clamps, forced `Single` loops, synthetic single-particle motion, and density/capacity multipliers are rejected from canonical runtime fixtures
   - NeverBlender's hidden emitter plane is accepted only as authoring UI for `xsize/ysize`, not as particle draw geometry, collision geometry, or a Blender emission source
   - free-list particle reuse calls the reset/recontextualization path before the particle can contribute to active render output
   - Blender/NeverBlender defaults produce `VFX_BLENDER_DEFAULTS_NOT_AURORA_RUNTIME` or `VFX_NEVERBLENDER_DEFAULTS_AUTHORING_ONLY` when used as runtime proof
7. Blender/NeverBlender separation:
   - Blender `ParticleSettings` is accepted only as an authoring/metadata carrier, not as an Aurora runtime schema
   - Shared Blender `ParticleSettings` data-blocks record shared-ID provenance and object/system owners; they do not collapse multiple possible Aurora emitter owners into one source object.
   - Blender `ParticleSettings` being reusable by multiple particle systems is a required import invariant; importer output records all owner objects/systems that reference the same settings ID.
   - NeverBlender's `ParticleSettings.nvb` is an addon `PointerProperty` schema carrier; missing registration or missing pointer data emits schema diagnostics instead of deleting Aurora fields.
   - Missing NeverBlender `ParticleSettings.nvb` schema produces `VFX_BLENDER_NVB_SCHEMA_UNAVAILABLE`; it is not evidence that Aurora fields were absent.
   - Blender custom/ID properties outside known NeverBlender or adapter schemas produce `VFX_BLENDER_UNKNOWN_CUSTOM_PROPERTY_AUTHORING_ONLY`; schema-looking properties without registered add-on/version/source provenance produce `VFX_BLENDER_IDPROPERTY_SCHEMA_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED`; using `ParticleSystem` runtime state as the custom-property schema emits `VFX_BLENDER_PARTICLESYSTEM_NOT_IDPROPERTY_SCHEMA`
   - NeverBlender-created emitter mesh objects can be hidden from render and paired with a `PARTICLE_SYSTEM` whose `settings.count = 0`; this is treated as explicit metadata-carrier evidence, not a working Blender simulation.
   - Blender evaluated `ParticleSystem.particles`, `child_particles`, `point_cache`, seed/current-step state, and editability flags are ignored for canonical Aurora runtime construction
   - Blender `ParticleSettings` and `ParticleSystem` default values are never treated as Aurora runtime constructor defaults
   - Blender `ParticleSettings.lifetime`, `frame_start`, `frame_end`, and `count` never map to Aurora `lifeExp`, `loop`, or `birthrate` unless a NeverBlender/Aurora field mapping explicitly supplies the source row
   - Blender `ParticleSettings.render_type` never maps to Aurora emitter `render`
   - Blender object `hide_render`, collection visibility, viewport/render flags, and particle render panel state never map to Aurora `propagaterender`
   - Blender `ParticleSettings.count`, frame range, point cache, child/path cache, baked/editable state, and current evaluated particle state never become canonical Aurora active/free particle state
   - Blender `ParticleSystem.particles` and `ParticleSystem.child_particles` are ignored for canonical runtime and emit `VFX_BLENDER_PARTICLE_SYSTEM_RUNTIME_SURFACE_IGNORED` if used as Aurora active particles
   - Blender Newtonian/Keyed/Boids/Fluid physics settings emit `VFX_BLENDER_NEWTONIAN_INTEGRATOR_NOT_AURORA_SOLVER` or `VFX_BLENDER_KEYED_BOIDS_FLUID_NOT_AURORA_UPDATE` when used as Aurora `update` proof
   - Blender force-field data (`EffectorWeights`, `FieldSettings`, global gravity, Wind effector) emits `VFX_BLENDER_EFFECTOR_WEIGHTS_NOT_AURORA_MANAGER` or `VFX_BLENDER_FIELD_SETTINGS_NOT_AURORA_BLAST` when used as Aurora wind/blast proof
   - Blender Collision/Deflection data emits `VFX_BLENDER_COLLISION_DEFLECTOR_NOT_AURORA_QUERY` or `VFX_BLENDER_COLLISION_CACHE_NOT_AURORA_RUNTIME` when used as Aurora `bounce`/`splat` collision proof
   - current frontend collision overlay rings emit `VFX_FRONTEND_COLLISION_OVERLAY_NOT_VFX_COLLISION` if used as particle collision, walkmesh contact, bounce, splat, or landed-flag evidence
   - `surfacemat.2da`, `GetSurfaceMaterial`, WOK/PWK/DWK walkability, and public `Walk`/`WalkCheck` docs emit `VFX_PARTICLE_COLLISION_SURFACEMAT_NOT_SERVICE_PROOF` or `VFX_PARTICLE_COLLISION_WALKCHECK_NOT_BOUNCE_FILTER` when promoted from surface-context evidence into canonical particle-collision inclusion policy
   - PoC `walkable_surface_ids`, browser `walkSurfacePolicy`, walk-hit selection, spawn placement, and camera collision emit `VFX_POC_WALK_SURFACE_NOT_VFX_COLLISION` when used as Aurora VFX `bounce`, `splat`, landed-flag, or particle `threshold` proof
   - missing evidence grade/source mesh type on a particle collision surface annotation emits `VFX_PARTICLE_COLLISION_SURFACE_CONTEXT_PROFILE_GATED`; canonical mode cannot silently treat a walkmesh material row as mapped collision-service behavior
   - Blender child-particle counts and child render amounts never multiply Aurora active particles and emit `VFX_BLENDER_CHILD_PARTICLES_PREVIEW_ONLY` when treated as runtime particles
   - Blender Render panel modes (`None`, `Halo`, `Path`, `Object`, `Collection`) are recorded only as Blender authoring/preview renderer state and produce `VFX_BLENDER_RENDER_AS_RENDERER_ONLY` if used as Aurora emitter render-mode proof
   - Blender Render `Path`, Hair particle paths, and Keyed path visualization emit `VFX_BLENDER_PATH_RENDER_NOT_AURORA_TRAIL` if used as Aurora `spawntype Trail`, movement-distance emission, or residual-vector proof
   - Blender cache start/end frames, positive-frame simulation limit, playback cache fill, bake protection, and particle-edit cache requirements produce `VFX_BLENDER_CACHE_FRAME_ENVELOPE_NOT_AURORA` if used as Aurora lifetime/spawn proof
   - Blender scene `fps`/`fps_base`, timeline preview range, frame dropping, and `Scene.frame_set()` evaluated updates are recorded as `BlenderTimebaseEvidence`, not as Aurora source time
   - Blender frame-to-seconds conversions require source path, scene FPS/base, frame origin, selected Aurora profile, and tolerance; missing evidence emits `VFX_BLENDER_FRAME_TO_SECONDS_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED`
   - `Scene.frame_set`, depsgraph/evaluated meshes, evaluated particles, Geometry Nodes caches, and particle caches emit `VFX_BLENDER_FRAME_SET_EVALUATED_STATE_ONLY`, `VFX_BLENDER_DEPSGRAPH_EVALUATED_NOT_SOURCE`, or `VFX_BLENDER_SIM_CACHE_NOT_AURORA_TICK` if used as source/runtime proof
   - timeline preview range, playback sync, and frame-dropping state emit `VFX_BLENDER_TIMELINE_PREVIEW_RANGE_NOT_SOURCE` when used as VFX lifetime, cycle, or event scheduling evidence
   - Blender `ParticleData` previous/current state never replaces Aurora previous-position slots required by `Motion_Blur`
   - Blender `ParticleSettings.angular_velocity_factor`, `angular_velocity_mode`, rotation phase/randomness, dynamic rotation, and orientation-axis controls are stored only as Blender authoring/preview state and emit `VFX_BLENDER_ANGULAR_VELOCITY_NOT_AURORA_PARTICLEROT` if used as canonical `particleRot` units or update-state proof
   - Blender object/collection particle rendering never becomes Aurora `chunkName` model resolution
   - Blender object/collection `Render As` instancing produces `VFX_BLENDER_RENDER_AS_INSTANCE_NOT_CHUNK` when a caller tries to use it as chunk-particle proof
   - Blender Geometry Nodes / Simulation Zone data is preview-only unless an explicit future Blender-tooling feature preserves it separately
   - Blender Geometry Nodes bake data is never treated as an import/export format for Aurora VFX
   - Blender docs/current evidence is accepted only as API/spec evidence and emits `VFX_BLENDER_CURRENT_DOCS_NOT_LOCAL_RUNTIME` if used to claim local runtime/addon compatibility
   - local Blender adapter fixtures require a `BlenderRuntimeProbe`; missing executable path or version emits `VFX_BLENDER_RUNTIME_PROBE_REQUIRED` / `VFX_BLENDER_EXECUTABLE_NOT_FOUND`
   - Blender material alpha mode never maps directly to Aurora emitter `blend`
   - Blender `blend_method`/`surface_render_method` compatibility is version-handled without changing Aurora blend semantics
   - Blender alpha-mode adapter fixtures record Blender version, source property (`blend_method` vs `surface_render_method`), raw enum value, `alpha_threshold`, transparent-overlap/backface-culling flags, and emit `VFX_BLENDER_MATERIAL_ALPHA_PROPERTY_VERSION_SCOPED` if any of those are missing from a round-trip package
   - Blender material adapter fixtures emit `VFX_BLENDER_MATERIAL_API_VERSION_REQUIRED` if `blend_method`/`surface_render_method` is interpreted without Blender-version provenance
   - Blender `DITHERED` and `BLENDED` preview values emit `VFX_BLENDER_DITHERED_NOT_PUNCH_THROUGH` / `VFX_BLENDER_BLENDED_NOT_AURORA_NORMAL_OR_LIGHTEN` when used as source truth for Aurora `Punch-Through`, `Normal`, or fallback/mode-`2`
   - Blender transparent-overlap/object-sorting choices emit `VFX_BLENDER_TRANSPARENCY_OVERLAP_NOT_RENDERORDER` if they affect Aurora `renderorder` or draw-queue keys
   - imported NeverBlender `PARTICLE_SYSTEM` with `settings.count = 0` is treated as metadata carrier evidence, not simulation output
   - NeverBlender-specific fixtures require installed addon version/hash/path evidence and emit `VFX_NEVERBLENDER_ADDON_NOT_INSTALLED_PROFILE` when only official Blender docs or old NeverBlender source snippets are available
   - NeverBlender split storage is normalized: native `normal_factor`/`factor_random`/`angular_velocity_factor` round-trip as Aurora `velocity`/`randvel`/`particleRot`, while `settings.nvb` fields remain Aurora metadata
   - imported `ParticleSettings.nvb.particletype` is not trusted over raw `chunkName`/`texture`
   - NeverBlender's local import path attempts to set `particletype` from `chunkname` but uses a comparison expression, so `particletype` is treated as UI state only and emits `VFX_BLENDER_PARTICLETYPE_NOT_CHUNK_PROOF` when used as lane proof
   - PoC white-quads, placeholder boxes, and generic shared-mesh instancing for `chunkName` are marked preview-only unless they are fed by canonical `AuroraChunkParticleInstance` records
   - NeverBlender `ParticleSettings.nvb.deadspace` is preserved as authoring metadata with unknown runtime meaning because its UI description is `???`
   - NeverBlender emitter plane mesh dimensions round-trip only as `xsize`/`ysize` authoring metadata, never as runtime particle geometry
   - NeverBlender imported F-Curves with `LINEAR` interpolation emit a linearization-risk diagnostic unless raw Aurora key/bezier-key tracks are also present
   - Blender `Action.fcurves` usage records Blender version/action-slot provenance and emits `VFX_BLENDER_ACTION_FCURVES_LEGACY_SLOT` / `VFX_BLENDER_ACTION_FCURVES_FIRST_SLOT_ONLY` when future layered-action data cannot be fully represented by the legacy first-slot F-Curve view
   - Blender Action layers/slots outside the legacy first-slot view emit `VFX_BLENDER_ACTION_SLOT_UNRESOLVED` and stay `blenderAuthoring` until a future mapping is proven
   - Blender F-Curve evaluated values, modifiers, sampled points, mute/valid state, and extrapolation remain `blenderAuthoring` facts and emit `VFX_BLENDER_FCURVE_EVALUATION_AUTHORING_ONLY` / `VFX_BLENDER_FCURVE_MODIFIERS_AUTHORING_ONLY` if used as Aurora evaluator proof
   - NeverBlender `fieldkey` export is accepted only for properties present in `Emitter.property_dict` / `object_properties`; exporting or importing unknown animated Aurora fields through NeverBlender alone emits `VFX_NEVERBLENDER_FIELDKEY_EXPORT_KNOWN_FIELDS_ONLY` or `VFX_NEVERBLENDER_UNKNOWN_ANIM_FIELD_NOT_ROUNDTRIPPED`
   - NeverBlender animation events round-trip through scene FPS, so event source seconds and exported frame-derived seconds are compared with tolerance and provenance
   - missing NeverBlender fields do not remove Aurora-decompilation-confirmed parser fields
   - unknown emitter fields survive our parser even when NeverBlender would not preserve them as exportable data
   - Blender viewport/material previews are labelled non-canonical when used for human inspection
   - `auroraRaw`, `auroraNormalized`, and `blenderAuthoring` payloads stay separate in any future Blender import/export path
   - Blender adapter packages include `adapterVersion`, `blenderVersion`, selected Aurora profile, addon version when present, source provenance, and diagnostics; missing metadata emits `VFX_BLENDER_ADAPTER_VERSION_REQUIRED`
   - adapter round-trip tests compute and compare `auroraRawHash`; mismatch blocks silent export and emits `VFX_BLENDER_EXPORT_RAW_HASH_MISMATCH`
   - `auroraRaw`, `auroraNormalized`, `blenderAuthoring`, and `blenderPreview` are four separate lanes; collapsing them emits `VFX_BLENDER_ADAPTER_PAYLOAD_SPLIT_REQUIRED`
   - Blender export admission tests produce `AuroraVfxBlenderExportAdmission` and fail closed when field mapping, raw hash, unit/timebase provenance, selected profile, or explicit user intent is missing
   - Blender authoring-only metadata changes persist without changing Aurora source and are reported separately from raw mutations
   - unknown Aurora raw fields, unknown 2DA columns/cells, key rows, Bezier rows, event rows, and unsupported resource refs survive round-trip or emit `VFX_BLENDER_EXPORT_UNKNOWN_FIELD_PRESERVE_REQUIRED`
   - POC comparison data from `Areas Generator 3d`, including scale/density/alpha multipliers, synthetic single-loop behavior, missing-texture aliases, local billboard overrides, and `preview_cycle_length`, emits `VFX_BLENDER_EXPORT_POC_HEURISTIC_BLOCKED` if proposed as an Aurora source mutation
   - PoC `preview_cycle_length`, `life_exp` clamps, life jitter, normalized-age denominator clamps, density-scaled capacity, and `deltaSeconds` integrator helpers emit `VFX_POC_PREVIEW_CYCLE_LENGTH_HEURISTIC`, `VFX_POC_LIFEEXP_CLAMP_HEURISTIC`, `VFX_POC_LIFEEXP_JITTER_PREVIEW_ONLY`, `VFX_POC_LIFETIME_NORMALIZED_AGE_CLAMP_PREVIEW_ONLY`, or `VFX_POC_DELTA_INTEGRATOR_NOT_AURORA_TICK` if promoted to canonical Aurora runtime
   - Blender Action/F-Curve exports block with `VFX_BLENDER_EXPORT_ACTION_SLOT_UNSAFE` unless action slot/layer/channelbag provenance and target Aurora controller family are complete
   - preview-only Geometry Nodes, point-cache, material, viewport, or generated geometry changes never write into Aurora source fields and emit `VFX_BLENDER_PREVIEW_LANE_EXPORT_BLOCKED`
   - Geometry Nodes bake data emits `VFX_BLENDER_GEONODES_BAKE_VERSION_UNSTABLE` or existing bake-format diagnostics if used as storage/import evidence
   - Blender Action/F-Curve imports preserve slot/layer/channelbag provenance and emit `VFX_BLENDER_ACTION_SLOT_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED` before using legacy first-slot F-Curve data as editable metadata
   - `Areas Generator 3d` VFX runtime cases are loaded only as `pocComparison` fixtures and emit `VFX_BLENDER_POC_COMPARISON_ONLY` if any scale/density/fallback formula is promoted to canonical Aurora behavior
   - Blender export diffs report raw Aurora field divergence, preview-only divergence, split-storage mismatch, `chunkName`/`texture` vs `particletype` conflict, F-Curve time conversion, and unsupported `fieldbezierkey` preservation
   - local `backend/tmp_cot_fx01.mdl` can serve as a baseline Fountain/atlas/texture validation fixture, but passing that fixture does not prove Explosion, P2P, Lightning, chunk, or beam behavior
   - NeverBlender `renderorder` is authoring/export evidence only; Aurora decompilation owns the runtime draw-item tie-breaker semantics
8. Resource/material validation:
   - every VFX resource lookup records resolver policy ID/version, candidate trace, winner layer, requested resource class, and source field path
   - every resolve result exposes an explicit status (`resolved`, `unresolved`, `unsupportedClass`, `profileBlocked`, or `deferred`) and emits `VFX_RESOURCE_RESOLVE_STATUS_REQUIRED` if status is missing
   - preload requests carry preload intent and source owner edge; missing owner/intent emits `VFX_RESOURCE_PRELOAD_INTENT_REQUIRED` or `VFX_RESOURCE_PRELOAD_OWNER_EDGE_REQUIRED`
   - resolver cache keys include resolver policy ID/version, selected source stack, requested resource class, normalized key, source field path, sidecar role, and consumer lane; weaker keys emit `VFX_RESOURCE_CACHE_KEY_POLICY_REQUIRED`
   - VFX resolver cache keys include runtime-settings revision, source category/policy name, HAK mode, selected profile ID or inline-list marker, ordered HAK list hash, module identity, and selected source layer; weaker keys emit `VFX_RESOURCE_CACHE_KEY_HAK_PROFILE_REQUIRED` / `VFX_INTEGRATION_HAK_PROFILE_HASH_REQUIRED`
   - VFX source categories are explicit. Until runtime-settings grows `sources.vfx`, a temporary adapter that reuses `sources.placeable` must label itself as project policy evidence and emit `VFX_INTEGRATION_VFX_SOURCE_POLICY_REQUIRED`; silent category reuse emits `VFX_RESOURCE_RESOLVER_CATEGORY_SPLIT_REQUIRED`
   - selected 2DA rows and selected resource files carry table/resource hash, source layer, source path/archive member, and selected profile; missing provenance emits `VFX_RESOURCE_SELECTED_TABLE_HASH_REQUIRED`
   - lower-precedence rows, cells, and resources are not merged into the selected source. Merge-by-convenience emits `VFX_RESOURCE_SOURCE_LAYER_MERGE_FORBIDDEN`, unless a separate resolved/merged artifact exists with its own hash and policy provenance
   - runtime-settings `includeHaks`, `hakPriorityList`, `hakProfileId`, and resolved `hakPaths` are project configuration inputs and emit `VFX_INTEGRATION_RUNTIME_SETTINGS_NOT_RETAIL_PRECEDENCE` if used as retail/Aurora precedence proof without selected-client validation
   - benchmark candidates are fixture selectors only and emit `VFX_BENCHMARK_CANDIDATE_NOT_SOURCE_PROFILE` if used to infer source profile, HAK order, or canonical VFX row selection
   - `cachedmodels.2da` rows are accepted only under an EE/profile-gated residency policy; missing source profile/local-symbol boundary emits `VFX_CACHEDMODELS_TABLE_EE_PROFILE_REQUIRED` or `VFX_CACHEDMODELS_LOCAL_SYMBOL_ABSENT`
   - cached-model residency records do not create VFX instances, phase schedules, hardcoded event provenance, or `progfx.2da` Type 8/9 proof; violations emit `VFX_CACHEDMODEL_RESIDENCY_NOT_EFFECT_INSTANCE`, `VFX_CACHEDMODEL_RESIDENCY_NOT_PHASE_SCHEDULE`, `VFX_CACHEDMODEL_ROW_NOT_HARDCODED_EVENT`, or `VFX_CACHEDMODEL_NOT_PROGFX_TYPE8_TYPE9_PROOF`
   - table-only model preload has no owner edge until a later VFX/model consumer uses the MDL; missing separation emits `VFX_CACHEDMODEL_NO_OWNER_EDGE_FOR_TABLE_PRELOAD` or `VFX_CACHEDMODEL_LATER_CONSUMER_EDGE_REQUIRED`
   - cached-model cache keys include profile, selected source stack, source layer, resource class, normalized resref, row/cell path, residency policy, and later consumer lane when present; weaker keys emit `VFX_CACHEDMODEL_CACHE_KEY_SOURCE_STACK_REQUIRED`
   - PoC/browser/material caches remain adapter-performance facts and emit `VFX_POC_BROWSER_CACHE_NOT_AURORA_RESIDENCY` or `VFX_POC_MATERIAL_CACHE_NOT_AURORA_EFFECT_CACHE` if promoted to Aurora resource residency/effect cache semantics
   - HAK/module winner conflicts emit runtime-precedence-unverified diagnostics until retail validation proves the policy
   - lower-precedence candidates remain in the trace and emit `VFX_RESOURCE_LOWER_PRECEDENCE_TRACE_REQUIRED` if the trace is discarded
   - lower-precedence rows/cells/resources are not merged into the selected winning table/resource
   - raw resref and normalized lookup key are both preserved when they diverge
   - over-profile-length resrefs emit profile-limit diagnostics before lookup truncation or rejection
   - ResMan-style missing diagnostics are preserved as resource-edge diagnostics and emit `VFX_RESOURCE_RESMAN_MISSING_DIAGNOSTIC_PRESERVED` if dropped
   - project resolver policy can mark preview availability, but emits `VFX_RESOURCE_PROJECT_POLICY_NOT_RETAIL_PROOF` if used as retail/Aurora proof without selected-profile validation
   - emitter `texture` raw token, normalized resref, `NULL` state, and provenance are preserved separately from mesh material names
   - non-empty source `chunkName` selects the chunk lane even when `texture` is missing or `NULL`
   - `texture NULL` with no `chunkName` emits `VFX_TEXTURE_NULL_NO_CHUNK_NO_TEXTURED_DRAW` rather than synthesizing a chunk or placeholder texture
   - missing texture resource on the textured-particle lane emits `VFX_TEXTURE_RESOURCE_MISSING_DIAGNOSTIC` without dropping the emitter
   - missing resources preserve unresolved dependency edges and emit `VFX_RESOURCE_MISSING_EDGE_PRESERVED` if missing edges are collapsed into null previews
